answer: A PoA market can make each new agent post a refundable bond before its claims earn rewards. A spiral of independent tasks releases the bond only after delayed audits; a tundra of failed or copied identities loses it to honest reviewers. A saffron-sized bond must exceed the value of one short-lived fake account, so an attacker creating thousands of Sybils must lock that much capital per identity and risks losing it on detection.
